description: This file defines API endpoints for managing appointments in a healthcare system. It includes functions for booking appointments, confirming/rejecting appointments by doctors, listing user-specific appointments, and retrieving appointment details. The code uses FastAPI for defining routes, SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions, and dependency injection for user and database context.
